warmup_policy: previous_calendar_year; require qualified coverage and all strategy warmups
sample_policy: Freeze all D01-qualified symbol-year windows before any strategy calculation; retain all losses; no replacement securities
fee_assumption: P5-R02 unchanged: commission 3bps/minimum CNY5, slippage 5bps, transfer 0, sell stamp duty 10bps for 2015-2018; uniform research assumptions, not historical broker certification
completion_policy: Predeclared before first real calculation: completed requires >=12 distinct securities, >=3 complete annual research years and >=4 economic categories; otherwise partial. All windows require >=240 research sessions and >=50 previous-calendar-year warmup sessions inside one D01-qualified continuous interval; synthetic results never qualify
